# Supernote TypeScript fixtures

These notebooks and mark files come from Brandon Philips’s supernote-typescript project and retain its [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). The corpus includes the imported background in the Moonchild notebook and the embedded artwork in the sticker notebook. [Upstream input directory](https://github.com/philips/supernote-typescript/tree/52dde1ecb0735d76df56e33226e80045339feb06/tests/input).

Upstream renamed the fixtures to describe their purpose, device and format. The table gives their earlier names under `tests/input/`. At the imported revision all 27 local basenames and file contents match upstream. [Upstream rename](https://github.com/philips/supernote-typescript/commit/49c3e5c525ed8a0127ab051764d98d92b1019686).
